comment: Independent polyself.c polymon() witness for the stuck-mimic test at 775-778, which tests the hero's current form, not the new one. A Caveman (no magic resistance) wearing polymorph control eats a blessed tin of small mimic meat while a six-turn #wizintrinsic levitation hangs over a wished polymorph trap; the levitation ends during the 20 helpless turns, float_down() springs the trap, and the controlled polyself() chooses a small mimic. C calls unmul(""), so eatmdone() drops the gold disguise and the hero acts at once; adjacent melee cannot reach this state because mattacku() unmasks the hero first.
